items.title: Stuart Bergen Interview, 1970-07-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Did you ever know him? No. [INTERVIEWEE] I don't remember a trumpet player. I know one thing... he used to have a band at Lane's Mill when I was a kid.

ctx.x: And when my sister was coming out we hired a band and he got the band for us. I was only a kid. I only had a bugle. Maybe I didn't even have a cornet then. Or maybe I did. I guess I might have had a cornet. I don't know. Did you? Go ahead. They had a pretty good band. It was a pretty good band. He played the bass field that night.
Did you tell me something about Guy Kelly once? Did you ever know him? No.
I don't remember a trumpet player. I know one thing, Dick, I don't know how corny it was but he used to have a band at Lane's Mill when I was a kid. You all probably never did hear of those guys.
